reason: DottedThenHeader is the only witness and it also holds if add_pending set EXPLICIT_NEST immediately; the deferral itself (two dotted keys sharing a prefix in one table, 'a.b=1\na.c=2', which would then raise 'Cannot redefine namespace') is never stated.

name: Flags.finalize_pending
reason: The single 'K.x=true\n[K]' scenario still holds if finalize_pending set the flags recursively or never cleared the set; neither recursive=False (observable as '[a.b.d]' after 'a.b.c=1' and another header) nor the clear() at :241 (observable after an array-of-tables reset) is pinned.

name: Flags.unset_all
reason: Scenarios 2 and 6 only contain flags under K, so an unset_all that cleared the whole flag tree satisfies TableRules; that it drops only the subtree under key (':245-249', observable as '[a]\n[[b]]\n[a]') is never stated.

name: Flags.set
reason: Only recursive=False is ever observed; the recursive=True branch (FROZEN on inline tables and arrays, :260 'recursive_flags') is set in key_value_rule and parse_inline_table but no theorem looks at a key below a frozen value, so a set that ignored recursive passes.

name: Flags.is_
reason: No theorem has a recursive flag on a proper prefix of the queried key, so the early 'return True' at :270-271 is never pinned; an is_ that ignored recursive_flags on parents satisfies every entry.
